pages.text: Put a Basic Capacitor into the upgrade slot of a machine that requires one.

Double-Layer and Octadic Capacitors raise the capacitor level to 2 and 3. Machines use that level differently. An upgrade can change processing speed, power cost, fuel efficiency or buffer size. Compare the displayed stats after installing it.

pages.title: Loot Capacitors
pages.text: Loot Capacitors have individual modifiers. Read the tooltip and try the capacitor in the intended machine to see which values it changes.
